notes.title: Wishlist A Promise Best Left Unkept – Aya Edition, Coming Soon On Early Access!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479300/A_Promise_Best_Left_Unkept__Aya_Edition/

Hey! The Aya Edition of A Promise Best Left Unkept is coming out soon on Early Access! It's an alternative version of A Promise Best Left Unkept where Aya is the main heroine. It brings a brand new narrative of more than 300k+ words long, with new events and characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43463546/166a2fc1c722c4d502910e926c7654b89d396edf.jpg[/img]

A Promise Best Left Unkept – Aya Edition branches out after the event during the business trip. Here are some of the features of the game:
[list]
[*] 300k+ words of new content
[*] Multiple perspective
[*] 40+ CG sets
[*] 30+ Animated sex scenes
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43463546/f7a33d6fbf9862e487090d1b7878e819503f6999.jpg[/img]

It would mean a lot if you guys could wishlist it!
Here's the link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479300/A_Promise_Best_Left_Unkept__Aya_Edition/
